category.name: Paragraphs
category.preferred_workflow: Prefer DocumentBuilder for simple insertions and formatting; employ direct Paragraph DOM traversal for counting, filtering, and structural edits; rely on TxtSaveOptions and TxtLoadOptions for plain-text operations, and apply custom logic when a required API is unavailable.

strict_api_bans: Do not call Run.Replace; modify Run.Text directly.
Do not reference non-existent namespaces such as Aspose.Words.Building.
Do not use Paragraph.GetLinesCount or any layout-specific line-count API.
canonical_patterns: Use Paragraph.ParagraphFormat to adjust alignment, spacing, indent, shading, and style.
Apply built-in styles via ParagraphFormat.StyleIdentifier and custom styles via ParagraphFormat.StyleName.
Insert empty paragraphs with DocumentBuilder.InsertParagraph() after moving the builder to the target node.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate only the specific paragraph or node that a task targets instead of asserting global paragraph counts.
Check for the existence of a member before using it, and fall back to alternative logic when the API is unavailable.
When detecting style separators, compare Run.Text to the Unicode unit separator character (U+001F) if Run.IsStyleSeparator is not present.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler reports CS0234 indicating that a referenced namespace such as Aspose.Words.Building does not exist.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code imports a namespace that is not part of the Aspose.Words library for the targeted version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the invalid namespace with the correct one, e.g., Aspose.Words.Saving or Aspose.Words.Loading.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official API reference for the exact namespace names before adding using directives.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler error CS1501 shows that InsertParagraph does not accept the supplied number of arguments.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code calls InsertParagraph with parameters that are not defined in the method signature.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Call InsertParagraph() without arguments after moving the builder to the desired node.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Verify method signatures in the documentation or IntelliSense before passing arguments.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 or CS0117 errors indicate that members like Document.AddBidiMarks, TxtSaveOptions.ExportHeadersFooters, Paragraph.IsInTable, or Run.IsStyleSeparator are unavailable.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code uses properties or methods that are not implemented in the current Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use supported alternatives such as TxtSaveOptions (which includes headers by default) or detect table membership via Paragraph.GetAncestor(NodeType.Table).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Check the version-specific API list and guard against unavailable members with conditional compilation or runtime checks.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails because Paragraph.GetLinesCount does not exist.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to call a layout-specific helper that is not part of the public API.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove the call and, if needed, approximate line count using document layout services or omit the feature.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Restrict code to documented APIs; avoid assumptions about internal layout calculations.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 indicates that Run.Replace is missing.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code tries to replace text via a non-existent method.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Assign the new string to Run.Text while preserving formatting.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Use Run.Text property for text updates and keep formatting unchanged.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime failures occur when the test asserts the total number of paragraphs instead of the targeted one.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Validation logic checks the whole document rather than the specific paragraph affected by the operation.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Validate only the paragraph(s) directly involved in the task.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Design assertions to target the exact nodes under test.

examples.task: Insert a new paragraph with custom text using DocumentBuilder.Writeln inside a document loop.
Insert an empty paragraph at a specific node using DocumentBuilder.InsertParagraph for precise placement.
Set paragraph alignment to center by modifying builder.CurrentParagraph.ParagraphFormat.Alignment property for the current paragraph.
Adjust paragraph line spacing to 1.5 lines by setting builder.CurrentParagraph.ParagraphFormat.LineSpacing to 1.5.
Set first line indent of a paragraph to half an inch using ParagraphFormat.FirstLineIndent property.
Apply built-in Heading1 style to the current paragraph by assigning ParagraphFormat.StyleIdentifier to StyleIdentifier.Heading1.
Apply a custom paragraph style named MyStyle by setting ParagraphFormat.StyleName property to the style name.
Use StyleIdentifier enumeration to select a locale-independent style for a paragraph, ensuring consistent formatting.
Retrieve the number of lines in a paragraph by calling Paragraph.GetLinesCount() and store the result.
Log each paragraph's line count to the console for debugging paragraph layout issues.
Insert a style separator run between two text runs to combine different paragraph styles within one paragraph.
Search document runs for StyleIdentifier.StyleSeparator to identify existing style separators for further processing.
Enable bi-directional marks before saving to plain text by setting Document.AddBidiMarks property to true.
Export a document to TXT format while preserving headers and footers by enabling ExportHeadersFooters option during save.
Export a document to TXT without headers and footers by setting ExportHeadersFooters option to false.
Load a plain-text file with DetectNumberingWithWhitespaces enabled to automatically recognize list items.
Convert detected plain-text list numbering into Word list structures after loading the document successfully.
Navigate to a specific paragraph index using DocumentBuilder.MoveToParagraph before applying formatting changes programmatically.
Modify paragraph spacing before and after by setting ParagraphFormat.SpaceBefore and SpaceAfter properties appropriately.
Set paragraph shading background color to light gray using ParagraphFormat.Shading.BackgroundPatternColor property.
Apply right-to-left paragraph direction by setting ParagraphFormat.Bidi property to true for Arabic text.
Insert an empty paragraph after a bookmark by moving the builder to the bookmark and calling InsertParagraph.
Remove all paragraphs that use a specific style identifier, such as StyleIdentifier.Quote, from the document.
Replace text within a paragraph while preserving its original formatting by using Run.Replace method.
Merge consecutive paragraphs that share identical formatting into a single paragraph to simplify document structure.
Split a long paragraph into multiple shorter paragraphs at specified character positions to improve readability.
Insert a paragraph with a page break before it by setting ParagraphFormat.PageBreakBefore property to true.
Set paragraph outline level to 2 for subheadings to ensure proper inclusion in generated table of contents.
Apply a specific paragraph style to all heading paragraphs using a style selector loop across the document.
Count the number of paragraphs that contain a given keyword and output the total count result.
Add a paragraph containing a hyperlink run and assign the built-in Hyperlink style to it.
Insert a paragraph with a field code such as DATE and format the field result using paragraph formatting.
Determine whether a paragraph resides inside a table by checking Paragraph.IsInTable property value.
Export paragraphs to plain text with line numbers prefixed by enabling line numbering option in SaveOptions.
Load a TXT file with list detection disabled and compare the resulting document's list formatting to enabled mode.

narrative.overview: The Paragraphs category addresses insertion, formatting, traversal, and export operations on Aspose.Words documents. Verified examples illustrate correct usage of DocumentBuilder for empty paragraph insertion, custom style application, style-separator handling, bi-directional mark saving, and plain-text loading with list detection.
narrative.purpose: Assist developers in implementing paragraph-level manipulations with Aspose.Words by enforcing supported APIs, correct namespace usage, and precise validation while avoiding common compilation and runtime pitfalls.
validation_priorities: Ensure that all required Aspose.Words namespaces are imported and that the project references the correct assembly version.
Confirm that every invoked member exists in the target version before compilation.
Scope assertions to the exact nodes affected by the operation.
maintenance_notes: Update the documentation whenever a new Aspose.Words version introduces or deprecates members referenced in the examples.
Add unit tests for each verified workflow to detect regressions in API signatures.
Periodically review the rules summary to incorporate newly discovered best-practice patterns.
